title: Windows Update preferences
description: Controls supported Windows Update preferences available on current Windows 11 editions. These preferences do not disable servicing or guarantee that Windows will never restart.

get_latest_updates_as_soon_as_available.description: Receive optional updates and gradual feature rollouts as soon as they are available for the device.

restart_notifications.description: Notify the interactive user when an installed update requires a restart.

update_other_microsoft_products.description: Receive updates for other Microsoft products alongside Windows updates.
